message.hypixelscout.title: Hypixel Scout
message.hypixelscout.refresh.tooltip: Forget every answer and look everybody up again. Costs one request per player.
message.hypixelscout.tab.title: tab list
message.hypixelscout.peek.hint: Aim at a player to see their stats
message.hypixelscout.game.no_key.hint: Everything here is read from the Hypixel API with your own key.
message.hypixelscout.game.not_in_game.hi: Join one and everybody in it appears here.
message.hypixelscout.game.waiting.hint: The players appear as the server lists them.
message.hypixelscout.game.nicked: Nicked — Hypixel knows nobody by this name
message.hypixelscout.game.subtitle: Level %s · %s old · %s wins
message.hypixelscout.teams.caption: Most dangerous first · %s
message.hypixelscout.teams.party.tooltip: Sends each enemy team's threat level and players to party chat, one line per team. Only when you press this.
message.hypixelscout.teams.team.tooltip: Sends each enemy team's threat level and players to your team, one line per team. Uses normal game chat — if you switched your channel with /chat party, it goes there instead. Not in Solo.
message.hypixelscout.teams.list.party.to: Sends every enemy to party chat, one line each with threat level, stars and FKDR, most dangerous first. Paced by the chat interval in Settings → Alerts.
message.hypixelscout.teams.list.team.too: Sends every enemy to your team, one line each with threat level, stars and FKDR, most dangerous first. Paced by the chat interval in Settings → Alerts. Not in Solo.
message.hypixelscout.lookup.caption: Anybody at all, in your game or not.
message.hypixelscout.queue.caption: Each slot is a key; press it anywhere on Hypixel to queue.
message.hypixelscout.queue.empty: No quick queue slot is set.
message.hypixelscout.queue.not_hypixel: Quick queue only works on Hypixel.
message.hypixelscout.profile.title: Player profile
message.hypixelscout.profile.empty: Type a name and press Enter.
message.hypixelscout.profile.nicked: Nicked: Hypixel has no profile under this name.
message.hypixelscout.profile.send.team.t: Sends this player's stats to your team in one line. Only inside a team game.
Sends this player's stats to your party in one line.
message.hypixelscout.settings.title: Hypixel Scout settings
message.hypixelscout.settings.key.toolti: Your personal key from developer.hypixel.net. It only reads public statistics and can be revoked there at any time.
message.hypixelscout.settings.hypixel_on: Ignore the quick queue keys on any other server, so they can never send a stray /play.
message.hypixelscout.settings.group.tool: Keep teammates together in the table, in the scoreboard's order.
Many players hide it; then it reads as ?.
message.hypixelscout.settings.beds_per_g: Beds broken in an average game. High means a rusher: guard your bed.
message.hypixelscout.settings.kills_per_: Kills in an average game. High means a fighter.
message.hypixelscout.settings.age.toolti: A young account with big numbers is usually an alt.
message.hypixelscout.settings.tooltip.to: The stats of whoever is under your crosshair, in a card below it.
message.hypixelscout.settings.walls.tool: Off on purpose: the tooltip is for players you can actually see.
message.hypixelscout.settings.tab.toolti: Replace the tab list with one that carries stats, faces and team colours — during Bedwars games only.
message.hypixelscout.settings.nametag_st: Put each player's star in front of their nametag.
message.hypixelscout.settings.nametag_fk: And their FKDR after it. Needs the stars on.
message.hypixelscout.settings.chat_hover: Hovering a player's name in chat shows their stats; clicking opens their profile.
message.hypixelscout.settings.nick_alert: Say in chat when somebody in the game turns out to be nicked.
message.hypixelscout.settings.streak_ale: Say in chat when somebody in the game is on a long winstreak.
message.hypixelscout.settings.keys.hint: Click, then press a key or a mouse button. Escape clears it.
message.hypixelscout.mode.off.tooltip: Never on screen. The Scout screen still lists everybody.
message.hypixelscout.mode.toggle.tooltip: The table key opens it and closes it again.
message.hypixelscout.mode.hold.tooltip: Up only while the table key is held, like the tab list.
message.hypixelscout.mode.game_start.too: Opens itself for the first twenty seconds of a game. The key still works.
message.hypixelscout.sort.name: Name
message.hypixelscout.key.stored: A key is stored. Test it to be sure it still works.
message.hypixelscout.key.saved: Key saved. Everybody is looked up again with it.
message.hypixelscout.key.malformed: That is not an API key — it looks like 1a2b3c4d-…, from developer.hypixel.net.
message.hypixelscout.key.result.invalid_: Hypixel refused the key: %s. Development keys expire after 3 days.
message.hypixelscout.key.result.rate_lim: The key works but is used up for the moment.
message.hypixelscout.editor.title: Move the table
message.hypixelscout.editor.hint.drag: Drag the table. Hold Shift to ignore the guides.
message.hypixelscout.editor.hint.keys: Arrow keys nudge it, scrolling resizes it.
message.hypixelscout.alert.nick: ⚠ %s is nicked — Hypixel has no profile under that name.
message.hypixelscout.alert.streak: ⚠ %s is on a %s game winstreak (%s FKDR).
message.hypixelscout.party.no_teams: No enemy teams to report on yet.
message.hypixelscout.report.solo: Solo has no team chat — the report would go to everybody. Use /scout party instead.
message.hypixelscout.report.nowhere: Party chat only works on Hypixel.
message.hypixelscout.report.no_stats: No stats for %s yet — look them up first.
message.hypixelscout.status.key: API key %s, %s of %s requests left this window.
message.hypixelscout.status.in_game: in a Bedwars game with %s players
message.hypixelscout.game.waiting_for_st: Looked up when the match starts
message.hypixelscout.game.look_up_now.to: Nobody is looked up in the waiting lobby, to save requests on players who leave before the start. This looks everybody up right away.
message.hypixelscout.settings.lobby.tool: Look players up already in the waiting lobby before a match. Off by default: the lobby fills and empties for minutes, and everybody who leaves before the start is a request spent on nothing.
message.hypixelscout.threat_basis.absolu: The fixed bands, the same for every player, on stars × FKDR²: under 100 NONE, under 500 LOW, under 3 000 MED, under 10 000 HIGH, under 30 000 V.HIGH, under 150 000 EXTREME, above that INSANE.
message.hypixelscout.threat_basis.me.too: Measured against your own stars and FKDR: under a fifth of you is NONE, under half LOW, up to 1.5× MED, up to 2.5× HIGH, up to 4× V.HIGH, up to 10× EXTREME, beyond that INSANE.
message.hypixelscout.threat_basis.team.t: Measured against you and your teammates together (the geometric mean of your stats and their average), with the same bands as "me". A strong teammate raises the bar.
message.hypixelscout.settings.threat_sen: How dangerous every enemy is taken to be, compared with their numbers. Above 100% the levels come sooner (at 200% an enemy is rated as if twice as strong), below 100% only the worst stand out. Works with every "Threat vs" setting.
message.hypixelscout.settings.report_int: Time between two lines of a report or list sent to team or party chat. Without a rank Hypixel only lets you chat every 3 seconds, so then 3.2 s is used whatever this says.
message.hypixelscout.settings.report_fro: The lowest threat level the team and party reports name. Players below it are only counted — unless they are on a winstreak above your alert threshold. Nicks are always named.
message.hypixelscout.game.lobby.title: Waiting lobby
